T: The cover is not the book. Neither is the menu.
D: Mary Poppins comes back to Cherry Tree Lane to help the grown-up Banks children through hard times.
P: Serve the snacks when Jack and the lamplighters light up the London streets.
S: Hot toasted crumpets with butter melting into the holes, and honey or golden syrup. Toast 8 crumpets until crisp on the edges.
Cousin Topsy's fix-it shop that turns upside down
Upside-down toasts: bread pressed onto a pan of melted cheddar and fried until a lacy cheese crust forms, flipped and served.
the bathtub that turns into an ocean
Poached prawns on shredded lettuce in small glasses with a cocktail sauce of mayo, tomato sauce and lemon.
M: the Banks family home on Cherry Tree Lane
Chicken, leek and ham in a creamy sauce under a puff pastry lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes, with buttered peas.
the music hall show inside the painted bowl
Thick pork sausages browned slowly, served on buttery mash with an onion gravy cooked down for 20 minutes, and peas.
W: the balloon lady in the park
Shortcrust rounds filled with strawberry, apricot and blackcurrant jam, baked at 190C for 15 minutes.
K: Fresh lemonade with strawberries muddled in, poured over ice in tall glasses.

s.how: Toast 8 crumpets until crisp on the edges. Spread generously with 80g butter so it melts into the holes and serve with honey and golden syrup on the side.

s.note: Cousin Topsy's fix-it shop that turns upside down
s.how: Scatter grated cheddar in a hot buttered pan and press a slice of white bread on top. Fry until the cheese forms a golden lacy crust, then flip and toast the other side. Cut into fingers and sprinkle with chives. Upside down, of course.

m.note: the music hall show inside the painted bowl
m.how: Brown 8 thick pork sausages slowly in a pan. Cook 2 sliced onions in the same pan until soft, then add 500ml beef stock and simmer 20 minutes until thick. Serve the sausages on mash from 1kg potatoes with peas and plenty of gravy.

w.note: the balloon lady in the park
w.how: Cut shortcrust into rounds and press into a patty tin. Fill a third with strawberry jam, a third with apricot and a third with blackcurrant. Bake at 190C for 15 minutes until the pastry is golden. Dust the edges with icing sugar.

d.how: Muddle a handful of strawberries in a big jug. Add the juice of 6 lemons and sugar syrup to taste, then top with cold soda water. Pour over ice in tall glasses and take it to the park on a windy day.
